results.content:
The company plans to use the new capital to expand engineering, product and go-to-market teams as it scales its platform to secure AI SaaS ecosystems at global scale. [...] Reco’s client base includes several Fortune 500 companies and global enterprises across sectors such as finance, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, manufacturing and tech. AT&T Ventures joined as a strategic investor alongside new investors Forestay and Quadrille Capital. The financing brings Reco’s total funding to $140 million. The company plans to use the new capital to expand sales, partnerships, channel operations, and customer support as large enterprises deploy more autonomous and AI-enabled agents across business applications and workflows. Reco‘s platform [...] The catch: The nascent AI agent security market is rapidly evolving, with new threats and attack vectors emerging as agent capabilities advance.
